paragraphs: The wall trade receives retained seams and unresolved source or independent-review tasks. Broader preparation required for a replacement liner is an installation scope separate from affected removal. Original backing still unavailable at a corner remains identified before a new continuous finish closes the view, keeping provider status and reconstruction requirements clear for the association.

sections.heading: Client-directed records and practical notices
paragraphs: Findings, scope decisions, approvals and progress go directly to the designated client contact. Routine occupant messages follow the hiring manager’s or HOA’s instructions and approved wording, with accurate required safety and access information.

sections.heading: Mold provider arrangements and separate assessment
paragraphs: While Go Green’s Texas mold remediation license application is pending, work requiring a license is referred to appropriately licensed partner companies. The provider and scope are identified before work begins. Independent assessment or clearance is separate from remediation and is coordinated where required.
